'''''The Righteous'''''<ref name="Cat and Mouse Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode216.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cat and Mouse}}</ref> was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="Cat and Mouse" /> ''The Righteous'' fell in battle with the acclaimed [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] prior to the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]<ref name="Cat and Mouse Ep Guide" /> of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> As a member of the ''Venator''-class, it was 1,137 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length.<ref name="CCS" />

==Behind the scenes==
''The Righteous'' first appeared, labeled on a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] screen, in "[[Cat and Mouse]]," the sixteenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] name was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] in the episode,<ref name="Cat and Mouse" /> and the English translation was revealed in the corresponding [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|episode guide]] on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Cat and Mouse Ep Guide" />
